raw_segments.text: And is it true, Raskolnikov interposed once more suddenly, again in a voice quivering
with fury and delight in insulting him, is it true that you told your fiancé, within
an hour of her acceptance, that what pleased you most, was that she was a beggar, because
it was better to raise a wife from poverty so that you may have complete control over
her and reproach her with your being her benefactor?
